name: TR-MPC
author: sd88me
summary: A modular 16-slot drum kit mixing 606, 808, CW-78 and 909 voices per slot, with level, tune, decay, drive, pan and sends, shared reverb, delay and master chain, randomise, and a skin that reskins each slot. Gen1: the 6W6/8W8/CW-78/9W9 emulator-style DSP. Gen2: circuit-modelled 808 and 909.
